name: ZeroLimitAI
description: A seven-day no-card evaluation of an OpenAI-compatible model router.
overview: The evaluation key allows 25 calls per day for seven days; a paid plan is required afterward. The auto route selects from free upstream models and may substitute a requested model, identifying the model that answered in the response. The trial is for evaluation, not production.
free_access: Router may substitute the requested model
Evaluation only; paid plan required afterward
notes: Base URL https://www.zerolimitai.com/api/v1; inspect response model. No inference or billing test performed.
